tabs.tab_description: Selection-focused scripts for fast modelling workflows.
Geometry generation tools for rapid concept modelling.
Importers that convert external file data into SketchUp geometry.
Entity and container utilities for groups, components, and model organization.
Material-library utilities for loading Noble Architecture standard materials into the active model.
Tag-library utilities for loading Noble Architecture standard tags and line styles into the active model.
Miscellaneous utility tools for general workflow support.
Reload plugin data and Ruby files for rapid iteration.

buttons.tool_group_description: Selection tools for traversing related quad face loops.
buttons.description: Traverses connected quad rings using shortest opposite edges.

buttons.tool_group_description: Selection tools for traversing related quad face loops.
buttons.description: Traverses connected quad rings using longest opposite edges.

buttons.tool_group_description: Selection tools for traversing related quad face loops.
buttons.description: Picks the candidate ring direction with the highest face count.

buttons.tool_group_description: Tools for generating lattice bars from selected model edges.
buttons.description: Creates lattice bars with explicit width/depth/mode prompt.

buttons.tool_group_description: Tools for generating lattice bars from selected model edges.
buttons.description: Creates lattice bars immediately using saved width/depth/mode.

buttons.tool_group_description: Tools for grouping selected raw geometry into clean modelling units.
buttons.description: Groups each disconnected geometry island in the selection into its own SketchUp group.

buttons.tool_group_description: Tools for grouping selected raw geometry into clean modelling units.
buttons.description: Groups each individual face in the selection into a sequentially named SketchUp group.

buttons.tool_group_description: Tools for creating visual bounding geometry around selected objects.
buttons.description: Creates a grouped wire bounding box around the full extents of the current selection.

buttons.tool_group_description: Utilities for changing SketchUp entity containers without editing their raw geometry.
buttons.description: Converts selected component instances and nested component instances into independent SketchUp groups.

buttons.tool_group_description: Utilities for changing SketchUp entity containers without editing their raw geometry.
buttons.description: Loads a selected .skp file as a component and inserts it at world identity for Xref-style placement.

buttons.tool_group_description: Utilities for changing SketchUp entity containers without editing their raw geometry.
buttons.description: Converts selected groups into instances of a single shared component. Pick the inference group to set the component axes. Original world positions are preserved.

buttons.tool_group_description: Read-only tools for inspecting selected containers, children, loose geometry, and tags.
buttons.description: Opens a visual hierarchy tree for the current selection with tag summaries and optional sibling reporting.

buttons.tool_group_description: Build standard material sets from Noble Architecture SSOT data.
buttons.description: Loads only the modelling utility material series (MAT010).

buttons.tool_group_description: Build standard material sets from Noble Architecture SSOT data.
buttons.description: Loads the TrueVision basic materials palette (MAT100).

buttons.tool_group_description: Build standard material sets from Noble Architecture SSOT data.
buttons.description: Loads all indexed Noble Architecture materials from MAT010 onward.

buttons.tool_group_description: Build standard SketchUp tags, line styles, and tag colours from Noble Architecture SSOT data.
buttons.description: Loads all standard Noble Architecture tags and applies configured line styles such as Dash and Short dash.

buttons.tool_group_description: Build standard SketchUp tags, line styles, and tag colours from Noble Architecture SSOT data.
buttons.description: Loads helper and modelling utility tags such as orbit helper, clearance, linetype, door helper, and Profile Path Tracer tags.

buttons.tool_group_description: Build standard SketchUp tags, line styles, and tag colours from Noble Architecture SSOT data.
buttons.description: Loads the Layout drawing linework thickness tags and applies their configured MTE greyscale colours.

buttons.tool_group_description: Build standard SketchUp tags, line styles, and tag colours from Noble Architecture SSOT data.
buttons.description: Loads the compact TrueVision starter set: orbit helper, landscape, existing/proposed model roots, and storey containers.

buttons.tool_group_description: Build standard SketchUp tags, line styles, and tag colours from Noble Architecture SSOT data.
buttons.description: Loads all TrueVision export and storey tags while leaving modelling helper and line thickness tags separate.

buttons.tool_group_description: Tools for mirroring selected geometry using view-based or axis-constrained mirror planes.
buttons.description: Activates the interactive 2D mirror tool. Click two points to define the mirror axis; arrow keys lock to X/Y/Z axes. Works in parallel projection views.

buttons.tool_group_description: Tools for offsetting the perimeter of selected faces.
buttons.description: Offsets the perimeter of multiple selected faces at once, each in its own plane. Mouse or type a value (negative = outward); click or double-Enter to apply.

buttons.tool_group_description: Tools for removing unwanted or sub-threshold edges from selected geometry.
buttons.description: Prompts for a minimum edge length, then deletes all selected edges below that threshold using a group isolation strategy to preserve shared vertices.

buttons.tool_group_description: Flatten selected groups/components onto the current parallel-projection view as a new flat 2D group.
buttons.description: Projects all linework of the selected groups/components onto a camera-facing front plane and builds one new flat 2D group. The original 3D geometry is preserved. Requires Parallel Projection.

buttons.tool_group_description: Flatten selected groups/components onto the current parallel-projection view as a new flat 2D group.
buttons.description: Projects the selected groups/components onto a camera-facing front plane and keeps only the outline perimeter (interior holes preserved) as one new flat 2D group. Great for outlines and stencils. Requires Parallel Projection.

buttons.tool_group_description: Utilities for browsing and inspecting project image files.
buttons.description: Opens a dedicated image viewer for browsing any selected folder. Supports zoom, pan, rotate, and copy filepath. Ignores 00__Archive and 00__Ignore subfolders.

buttons.tool_group_description: Tools for importing 2D vector linework from external files.
buttons.description: Select a PDF and import its vector linework as edges, flattened to the XY plane and centred on the origin. Prompts for page (multi-page PDFs), scale factor and curve smoothness.

buttons.tool_group_description: Tools for tracing raster images into SketchUp edge linework.
buttons.description: Select a transparent-background PNG (trees, plants, people) and trace it into segmented edge linework. Live SVG preview with real-world size, minimum segment length and trace mode controls, then crosshair placement with 5mm snap.

buttons.tool_group_description: Development helpers for refreshing the plugin during active SketchUp sessions.
buttons.description: Reloads Ruby source and refreshes the dialog without restart.

buttons.tool_group_description: Development helpers for refreshing the plugin during active SketchUp sessions.
buttons.description: Checks the live GitHub raw JSON status for materials, tags, edge materials, and components without mutating the cache.
